verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships its own package ecosystem: NPM packages for all modules (with substantial download volume), first-party exporter plugins for 3ds Max, Maya and Blender, tools such as the Node Material Editor, Inspector and Sandbox, and integrations for several physics engines. Community mentions add third-party pieces like React-BabylonJS. However, there is no evidence of an asset store or marketplace offering ready-made models, and one user reports finding little active community outside Microsoft-run channels. missing for 10: an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, evidence of a large third-party plugin ecosystem, independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth.
